pages.title: Empirical Notes III
pages.text: The final third of the early record: gravitational lensing, all six quark flavours, spacetime lattices, fractals, neurons built of light. It ends abruptly, mid-thought, where I stopped measuring and started theorising. The last page is mostly arrows.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Bottom and top quarks next to up and down, a Minkowski lattice beside a fractal set, a gravitic lens element and a photonic neuron - closing the empirical record meant gathering the pieces that bridged particles, geometry and minds.
